 Print Friday, October 23, brings a fresh collection of films and series to streaming platforms, with crime, sports, mythology and regional cinema among the highlights. Omar Sy returns as Assane Diop in 'Lupin' Part 4, while 'Sumo Didi' tells the story of a pioneering Indian athlete. Check out the list here. 'Lupin' Part 4: Omar Sy returns to Netflix
 Omar Sy reprises his role as Assane Diop in the fourth part of the French crime series 'Lupin'. Set four years after the events of Part 3, the story finds Assane behind bars, hoping to build a new life with his family in Senegal. His plans are disrupted when a mysterious thief carries out coordinated robberies at museums across Paris and frames him for the crimes. Assane must escape prison, revive his Lupin persona and identify the real culprit to clear his name. The new instalment continues the character's journey through deception, elaborate schemes and high-stakes confrontations. 'Sumo Didi': Shriyam Bhagnani's sports drama on ZEE5
 'Sumo Didi' stars Shriyam Bhagnani as Hetal Dave, regarded as India's first female professional sumo wrestler. The biographical sports drama follows Hetal's journey from Kolkata to Japan as she pursues her ambition of competing in the World Sumo Championship. Her path is marked by gender stereotypes, body shaming and traditional attitudes about women participating in sports. The film focuses on her determination to challenge these barriers and establish herself in a discipline where female participation faces significant social resistance. 'Sumo Didi' will stream on ZEE5. Manoj Bajpayee's crime drama heads to Netflix
 Manoj Bajpayee plays Ajay Dixit, a corrupt Delhi police officer whose life takes an unexpected turn after an injured woman is thrown from a moving car. What begins as an investigation soon draws him into a murder conspiracy involving powerful individuals. As the case develops, Ajay faces a difficult choice between continuing his illegal activities and fulfilling his responsibilities as a police officer. The unfolding investigation forces him to confront the consequences of his actions. The film is scheduled to stream on Netflix. 'Fading Grandeur'
 Antonio de la Torre stars as Don Leandro, a disgraced Spanish marquis struggling with impending bankruptcy in 'Fading Grandeur'. Desperate to protect himself from financial ruin, he decides to sell his deteriorating mansion in Madrid. A potential buyer emerges when a wealthy and mysterious woman expresses interest in the property. However, what initially appears to be a straightforward business transaction develops into something more sinister. The woman's hidden motives threaten to complicate Leandro's attempt to save himself. 'Fading Grandeur' will stream on Netflix. 'The Legend of Hanuman' Season 7, 'Dhoomakethu' and 'Dorothy'
 'The Legend of Hanuman' returns for its seventh season on JioHotstar. The battle for Lanka intensifies as Ravan unleashes his most formidable form. Hanuman embarks on a mission through time, exploring forgotten chapters of Lord Ram's past before travelling to the kingdom of death in search of a powerful weapon. Malayalam film 'Dhoomakethu' also arrives on Netflix on October 23. Directed by Sudhi Maddison, the wedding-themed time-loop comedy stars Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal, Ganapathi S. Poduval, Shine Tom Chacko and Sidharth Bharathan. Tamil film 'Dorothy', directed by Karthik Subbaraj, is also scheduled to stream on Netflix. The cast includes Sananth, Rishikanth, Keerthy Suresh, Ramachandran Durairaj, Muthazhagi and Jeeva Subramanian.
